_comment: Curated publish titles (YouTube title + thumbnail header) per course, keyed by course id. Search-first: what someone would actually type, never 'Course 4'. One entry per course in src/content/index.ts.
first-program: Your First Java Program: javac, Bytecode And The JVM Explained

objects: Java Objects Explained: Classes, Records, Enums, equals And hashCode
interfaces: Java Interfaces, Inheritance, Sealed Types And Pattern Matching
failures: Java Exceptions, try-with-resources, JUnit Tests And Debugging
collections: Java Generics And Collections: Wildcards, HashMap, TreeSet, Big-O
streams: Java Lambdas And Streams: flatMap, Collectors, Optional, Parallel
